note: Rooftops move experts (tools/expert_bank.py builds each one's banks; gpu/pod_experts.sh trains them; tools/expert_eval.py judges them). One clip each, a float MLP from scratch, trained on 48 variants of the clip's own room (heights, gaps, distances, wall depths, unrelated boxes off her path) with start noise; judged on 16 held-out variants and in Rooftops itself (data/ac_course_bank.json room 0) on the obstacles its move is for. lift: all boxes raised together (m; the env raises the clip with what is under its start); dtop: each obstacle's top, independently (m); shift: each obstacle along her way and across it (m); depth: an obstacle's extent along her way (m, its near face kept; walls of Rooftops' alley are 0.26 m); boxes: unrelated boxes kept 0.9 m off her path. rooftops: [world box, her heading (deg: 0 = +z, 90 = +x)].
